title: Training date
passage: Has the software training been moved to Thursday? A. Yes, the trainer is unavailable on Wednesday. B. I use it every day. C. Move the files into that folder.
passageZh:
軟體訓練已經改到星期四了嗎？
A. 是的，講師星期三無法出席。
B. 我每天都使用它。
C. 把檔案移到那個資料夾。
